summary: G-III Apparel Group filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of the Marc Jacobs business from LVMH, effective September 1, 2026. The transaction was structured via a newly formed JV, MJ Topco, with WHP Global affiliate acquiring Marc Jacobs Holdings, after which G-III acquired the operating business while IPCo retained intellectual property. G-III funded its approximately $500 million investment through cash and revolving credit borrowings and will operate under an exclusive license from IPCo. A Transition Services Agreement with LVMH includes G-III guarantees. Watch for integration execution and license economics under WHP ownership.
